claim.claim-text: 2. The portable communication device of claim 1, wherein the housing (210) is a metal housing packaging the second display.

3. The portable communication device of claim 1, wherein at least a portion of the housing (210) protrudes from a surface of the second display (262b) toward an outside of the portable communication device (202).

4. The portable communication device of claim 1, further comprising: a shielding sheet (37a) at least partially disposed between the first display and the NFC antenna (397), and not disposed between the NFC antenna (397) and the second portion of the rear surface such that a wireless signal from the NFC antenna (397) is configured to be radiated through the second portion of the rear surface.

5. The portable communication device of claim 1, further comprising: a battery (389) at least partially disposed between the first display (261) and the NFC module (397) when viewed in the first direction.

6. The portable communication device of claim 1, further comprising: a processor and a luminance sensor (211) at least partially disposed under the first display (261), the processor configured to measure an external luminance through the luminance sensor (211).
7. The portable communication device of claim 1, further comprising a processor, the processor configured to:

receive a call from an external device, in response to receiving the call, display, via the first display (261), a first screen corresponding to the call, and based on an identification that a condition related with a position or an orientation of the portable communication device is satisfied, display, via the second display (262b), a second screen corresponding to the call.
8. The portable communication device of claim 8, wherein the processor is configured to: based on the identification that the condition is satisfied, deactivate the first display (261).

9. The portable communication device of claim 8, wherein the processor is configured to: perform the displaying of the second screen such that the second screen includes a first graphical user interface asking whether to allow or reject the call.
